C0233.title: Man Sentenced for Reselling Dating Site Member Accounts
C0233.summary: In January 2025, a Shanghai man surnamed Chang was sentenced to six months in prison and fined 5,000 yuan for purchasing and reselling over 100 real-name verified dating site accounts, some of which were later used in online fraud.
